newsitem.title: USA: Trinova to buy back up to $100 mln of shrs.
newsitem.headline: Trinova to buy back up to $100 mln of shrs.

text.p: Trinova Corp said Thursday it plans to buy back up to $100 million of its outstanding common shares.
The company said the buy back plan replaces and supersedes a purchase program that had been announced in 1995.
Trinova said its common shares may be purchased for cash from time to time in the open market and through privately negotiated transactions.
Purchased shares would become treasury shares and would be available for general corporate purposes, it said.
Trinova, which manufactures and distributes engineered components and systems to industrial, automotive and aerospace industries, had 27,990,991 shares outstanding at March 28.
A company spokesman said that under the previous buy back program, Trinova purchased 1,239,500 shares,at an average share price of $31.43, totaling $38.9 million.
